user.title: Irrigation Scheduler
user.description: All configuration is done from the Irrigation Scheduler panel.

state.overrun_restart: Time exceeded while HA was down
Time exceeded while HA was down

auto_unavailable.message: Auto mode needs a calculation method, not available yet.

zone_stopped.message: Zone {zone} is stopped. Re-enable it before watering.

valve_stopped.message: Valve {valve} is stopped. Re-enable it before watering.

run_zone.name: Run zone
run_zone.description: Queues every valve of the zone, respecting the zone and global limits.

run_valve.name: Run valve
run_valve.description: Opens one valve, respecting the global limit.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Duration. Defaults to the valve duration.

stop.name: Stop
stop.description: Closes open valves and manually switched-on valves, and clears queues. Without a zone, stops everything.

pause_valve.name: Pause valve
pause_valve.description: Cancels what was already triggered for the valve: clears its queue and turns it off. Later blocks still run.

set_valve_enabled.name: Enable or stop valve
set_valve_enabled.description: A stopped valve joins no block and no zone run. Stopping it also pauses it.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Off stops the valve; on re-enables it without watering.

set_zone_enabled.name: Enable or stop zone
set_zone_enabled.description: A stopped zone fires no blocks and rejects zone runs. Stopping it also pauses it. Its valves keep their state.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Off stops the zone; on re-enables it without watering.
